title: Gap Detection: Mitigating Homogenization through Demand and Defensibility
abstract: arXiv:2610.20162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models often produce semantically similar answers to open-ended questions, even when many plausible alternatives exist. Generating useful alternatives requires identifying both what the query calls for and what existing responses already cover. We introduce Gap Detection, a framework that searches for relevant but unoccupied directions in a shared text embedding space. Its objective, GapScore, combines query relevance (Demand) with dissimilarity to the nearest existing item (Defensibility). The framework optimizes this product on the unit sphere, maps candidate directions to concept words with a language model, and uses task-specific filtering and constrained prompting to turn those concepts into text. On five curated topics and 90 INFINITY-CHAT queries, the reported mean relative reductions in output Collision are 12.8% and 10.8%, respectively. translated_title: 差距检测：通过需求与可辩护性缓解同质化
translated_abstract: 语言模型在回答开放式问题时常常生成语义相似的答案，即使存在许多合理的替代方案。生成有用的替代方案需要同时识别查询所要求的内容以及现有回答已经覆盖的内容。我们提出了差距检测（Gap Detection），这是一个在共享文本嵌入空间中搜索相关但尚未被占据的方向的框架。其目标函数GapScore将查询相关性（需求，Demand）与最近现有条目的相异度（可辩护性，Defensibility）相结合。该框架在单位球面上优化该乘积，利用语言模型将候选方向映射为概念词，并通过任务特定的过滤和受约束的提示将这些概念转化为文本。在五个精选主题和90个INFINITY-CHAT查询上，报告的输出碰撞率平均相对降低分别为12.8%和10.8%。我们还将该框架实例化应用于四个产品的生成式引擎优化。
tldr: 提出Gap Detection框架，通过结合查询相关性（Demand）与现有内容相异度（Defensibility）的GapScore目标函数，在文本嵌入空间中检测相关但未被占据的方向，以缓解语言模型开放式回答的同质化问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Gap Detection, a framework that mitigates homogenization in language model outputs by searching for relevant but unoccupied directions in embedding space, optimizing a GapScore that combines query relevance (Demand) with dissimilarity to existing responses (Defensibility).
